guidanceConsulted.query: semantic HTML landmarks accessible tables keyboard navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), sequential heading hierarchy, <figure>/<figcaption> for embedded examples, <pre tabindex='0'><code> for keyboard-scrollable code blocks, and loading='lazy' with descriptive iframe titles.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer class='byline'>, <pre tabindex='0'><code> on all code blocks, and loading='lazy' with descriptive title on the CPS iframe.

guidanceConsulted.query: semantic HTML landmarks accessible tables keyboard navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide native table captions and <th scope='col|row'>, visible :focus-visible outlines on focusable scroll regions, and avoid redundant ARIA roles on native semantic elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: captioned tables with scope attributes, .table-wrap:focus-visible outline on scrollable table wrappers, and native landmarks without redundant ARIA.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible responsive documentation table code block without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing (inline-size, max-inline-size) and contained horizontal scrolling wrappers so wide tables and embeds never cause viewport horizontal overflow on mobile.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap and embedded iframe with overflow scrolling inside .table-wrap.
